test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7231769382199ec932939907821c33c22ea46f08011f0abe2d73182337919821.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: NSL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e74426a774b8ffabf41a1062d18a6c78ce88821e76f50895072fea86c2d6509.png] 

Option 2: HMF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c3f1eb5e7419ac20a23ebaaee5ff284a844e1ac2e70d9d5869a83d5617712e1.png] 

Option 3: PUN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5ff96084904cba3e606b401c3b324ae328fce2d608c477df1cc538c66f60a20.png] 

Option 4: RWO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4a1b3648a724795b1584b4546205aa2a4ae84423fb3d2bae5a31b951254dc85.png] 

Thus, RWO does not follow the pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 4.**
